<div class="card-body">
'''Scruffy-Looking Nerf Herder''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">みすぼらしいナーフ飼い</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ユーズド：「孤独なハン」、「戦士の勇気」、「知ってるさ」のいずれかをキャンセルする。ロスト：ハンとレイアが一緒に戦闘に参加している時に使う。運命数を2枚引く。合計値を、敵による損耗と合計戦闘力の値から引く（最低でも0より下には下がらない）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Scruffy-Looking-Nerf-Herder-PSA-82917273.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「でも、南の通路で俺たち二人きりだった所は見てないだろ。彼女は俺に本心を告げてくれたのさ」「な……この自惚れ屋で、気のきかない、みすぼらしいナーフ飼い！」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Scruffy-Looking Nerf Herder.

'''Card text:'''
USED: Cancel Solo Han, Warrior's Courage, or I Know. LOST: Use when Han and Leia are in a battle together. Draw two destiny. Subtract the total from opponent's attrition and total power. The values cannot fall below zero.

'''Lore:'''
But you didn't see us alone in the south passage. She told me her true feelings. Wha... you stuck-up, inconsiderate, scruffy-looking nerf herder!

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' USED names 「孤独なハン」, 「戦士の勇気」, and 「知ってるさ」 for Solo Han, Warrior's Courage, and I Know.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Scruffy-Looking Nerf Herder]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
